description: Three white paper cups with white plastic lids sit on the tabletop, spaced from left to right. The left hand and right hand reach toward the left cup and make it a two-hand object as they steady the cup and lift the lid off; the right hand sets that lid down on the table, then moves to the rightmost cup to pry off its lid and place it down as well, and finally both hands return to the center cup to remove its lid.
